_about: L4 — the minimal payload the model actually needs, for three real pairs. Track A's vector arm sent 53,299 tokens for five pairs and reported 70,631 total; a payload of this shape measured 3,940 tokens for the same five pairs (13.5x) and 20,483 tokens end to end against Vision's 38,069. The rule: the model never sees the block, only what changed, which objects it touched, before/after, the structural context needed to phrase it, and the uncertainty.
_rules: No hashes. Measured: 6,105 tokens of sha256/pattern ids in Track A's prompt that the model cannot cross-reference against anything.
No full text lists. Measured: L3.texts alone was 26,471 tokens, 49.7 % of the vector prompt.
No method telemetry (tolerance sweeps, unmatched id lists, coverage tables). Measured: 1,914 tokens of it.
No unreadable text. Measured: 13,232 tokens of spans the extractor itself flagged UNDECODABLE were sent anyway; on vk_nodes that was 60.7 % of the payload.
Every change carries its own confidence and evidence, so the model can refuse to phrase a weak one instead of guessing.
Crop artefacts are named as such and never presented as design changes.

payloads._caveat: This payload is what the v0.2 shape WOULD carry. The designation counts are measured (hybrid probe H10: Wh 0→4, QD 0→4, QF 0→4, ЩМкв 0→4, with zero false statements on the seven quiet pairs). The branch-cardinality change is NOT yet derivable from generic geometry: a relation graph over crude clusters gives ≈31 % precision on that statement (relgraph R11). It is derivable from designation counting, which is why designations must be a first-class identity carrier.

payloads._why_this_matters: This is the pair where Track A's vector arm produced its one clear false positive («добавлена позиция 1») and Vision was scored better. With page-level crop attribution the deterministic layer answers it correctly with zero model calls: 4 of 16 change events on this pair are provably crop artefacts, and the same predicate produced zero false attributions on the seven quiet pairs. Feeding that evidence to the model flipped its answer to the correct NEAR_IDENTICAL with zero major_changes.

_measured_sizes._note: The eom pair plateaus at 2.9x rather than 100x because a span/line diff has no notion that C11/C15/C25 are the same repeated object. That plateau is exactly the boundary between the backbone and the object layer.
